accepted.label: Naive Bayes Classifier Core Concept
accepted.description: Understanding the Naive Bayes classifier as a probabilistic method that applies Bayes' theorem with naive independence assumption to compute class posterior probabilities, without performing explicit calculations.
coverage_criteria: Describe how Naive Bayes uses Bayes theorem for classification
Identify that it is an eager learning algorithm
accepted.merge_rationale: Candidate lr005_001 covers the core conceptual understanding at application depth without probability computation, which is a distinct teachable idea from performing numerical calculations.

accepted.label: Naive Bayes Probability Calculation
accepted.description: Applying Bayes' theorem with independence to compute class-conditional probabilities from term frequencies for text classification.
coverage_criteria: State Bayes theorem and apply to classification
Explain independence assumption and its effect on factoring P(X|y)
Calculate class probability from term frequencies
accepted.merge_rationale: Candidate lr005_025 requires numerical calculation of probabilities, representing a deeper application behavior not present in lr005_001, thus merits a separate accepted concept.
